events.title: SLQ: Underwater Soundscape Composition Workshop
events.location: State Library of Queensland (The Edge), South Brisbane
events.description: Led by Dr. Leah Barclay, this hands-on workshop explores the art and science of underwater listening, guiding participants to create original soundscape compositions and engage with aquatic environmental thinking.

events.title: Redlands Coast AdventureFest
events.description: A free, community-led festival offering a wide range of outdoor and adventure activities for all ages, from adrenaline sports to nature excursions, appealing to adventurous and nature-focused individuals.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Okay, I Believe You (Auslan Comedy)
events.description: An Auslan-interpreted comedy show at Brisbane Comedy Festival, offering an inclusive and accessible stand-up experience in a community-focused atmosphere at the atmospheric Powerhouse.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights — Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: An evening experience at GOMA featuring the multi-sensory Olafur Eliasson exhibition, alongside live DJs, music, drinks, and a vinyl listening bar, fostering a social and artistic atmosphere.

events.title: Queensland Museum Lunchtime Lectures
events.description: Museum staff share insights into their latest research through free lunchtime lectures, offering a glimpse into diverse topics like local history, technology, and museum collections.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — City Walking Tour
events.location: Departing Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Regular guided walking tours led by the Museum of Brisbane, exploring the history, architecture, and hidden stories of the CBD, ideal for curious individuals seeking conversation and local insights.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — Sunday City Walking Tour
events.location: Departing Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Another opportunity to join a guided walking tour from the Museum of Brisbane, focusing on the history and architecture of the CBD, perfect for curious people interested in local stories and social connection.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Jiggle Jiggle (Josh Thomas)
events.description: Josh Thomas returns with his new show Jiggle Jiggle as part of Brisbane Comedy Festival's final week, offering quirky, authentic stand-up known for attracting diverse audiences.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Shad & Pete Save the World!
events.description: A late-night raw variety comedy show at Brisbane Comedy Festival, offering an intimate, unpredictable, and experimental experience for those seeking something different in performance art.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — Exhibition
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: An exclusive multi-sensory exhibition at GOMA featuring major works by Olafur Eliasson, exploring light, colour, perception, and human experience through interactive and immersive art installations.

events.title: Australian Cinémathèque: Double Take (Film Program)
events.location: Australian Cinémathèque, Gallery of Modern Art, South Brisbane
events.description: GOMA's curated cinema space presents Double Take, an ongoing program of international and art house films, offering a rare opportunity to engage with thoughtful film culture.

events.title: Dearly Departed: Death in Life — SLQ Exhibition
events.location: State Library of Queensland (SLQ), South Brisbane
events.description: A thought-provoking free exhibition at the State Library exploring themes of death, dying, memory, and remembrance through visual stories, including tarot card symbolism.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Bron Lewis
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse – Underground Theatre, New Farm
events.description: Stand-up comedian Bron Lewis presents her chaotic and hilarious observations on motherhood and life, performing in the intimate Underground Theatre as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival.

events.title: QSO Italian Gala
events.description: The Queensland Symphony Orchestra, led by Maestro Umberto Clerici, performs a passionate program of Italian classical music from Rossini to Puccini, featuring a unique Vivaldi Triple Concerto with cello, violin, and accordion.

events.title: QSO Maestro Series Preview Concerts: Rachmaninov & Shostakovich
events.description: The Queensland Symphony Orchestra presents two preview concerts featuring Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto No. 2, Shostakovich's 5th Symphony, and Cathy Milliken's Catalogue of Sky.

events.title: QSO Maestro Series: Rachmaninov & Shostakovich
events.description: The main Maestro Series concert of the week, featuring Rachmaninov's beloved Piano Concerto No. 2 and Shostakovich's emotional 5th Symphony performed by the Queensland Symphony Orchestra.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — Exhibitions & Residency
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Explore current exhibitions and a residency program at the Museum of Brisbane, located in City Hall, offering intellectually engaging cultural experiences focused on Brisbane's history and design.

events.title: GOMA Kids Tour: Presence & Play
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: A multi-sensory guided tour of the Olafur Eliasson exhibition, designed for families with children, offering playful experiences to spark imagination and build connection in a relaxed, crowd-free setting.
